## What's Changed
* Hover intent delay for navigation prefetching and TanStack Query option helpers by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/298
* Virtualize file tree and tune list overscan for large spaces by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/299
* Add file tree Open in New Window for markdown files by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/301
* Restore workspace ("start where I left off") (#302) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/302
* Harden editor document session and markdown lifecycle handling by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/305
* Support Unicode letters in tags by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/317
* Redistribute advanced settings into logical tabs by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/318
* Scale task checkboxes with editor font size by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/319
* Add UI translations (i18n) for high-traffic surfaces by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/320
* Add Raw Markdown Vim mode by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/325
* Open Finder Markdown files without showing Spaces by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/327
* Fix workspace tab restore on shutdown by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/328
* Remove space-open feature preloads by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/329
* Defer highlight.js grammar loading until a code block needs it by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/330
